## Purpose

Describe the user job and the smallest behavior changed.

## Verification

- [ ] Rust format, Clippy, and tests pass where applicable
- [ ] Swift tests/build pass for macOS changes
- [ ] MCP smoke test passes for tool or protocol changes
- [ ] Public-source relevance or package checks pass when affected
- [ ] No secrets, private data, PHI, assessment material, or restricted content added
- [ ] Documentation and rollback notes match the implementation

## Evidence and limits

List public test inputs, source/license implications, known failure states, security/privacy review, and what this change does not prove.
